title: Agudas Yisroel Convenes
body: Agudas Yisroel's Chassidishe Moetzes Gedolei HaTorah convenes Sunday to discuss Israel's proposed draft law, a critical issue in ongoing discussions.

title: Rav Aharon Meir Kravitz Passes
body: Rav Aharon Meir Kravitz zt”l, rosh kollel of Kollel Yotzei Chevron in Yerushalayim, passed away at 68 following a brief illness. He was a close talmid of Rav Yosef Shalom Elyashiv. His levayah is to be held.

title: Agudah Yerushalayim Yarchei Kallah
body: The Agudah Yerushalayim Yarchei Kallah brings Bnei Torah to Yerushalayim for intense limud haTorah and unique kedusha from Feb 15-19.
